purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
summary: Angola's national cadastral authority and official property-registration services are evidenced, but no Ondjiva-local public parcel viewer/API or safe anonymous parcel geometry response was found. No sample GeoJSON is retained; runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Portuguese discovery queries are recorded in city-3345-ondjiva.json. They identified IGCA, Inscreva Já and SIAC Registo Predial, but no Ondjiva-specific open parcel service.
requestOutcomes: Inscreva Já and MINFIN pages loaded HTTP 200. Current JavaScript inspection found an authenticated map/embed route; an anonymous POST to https://ggpen-maps.onrender.com/api/embed-url returned HTTP 400 authentication-required. IGCA direct GET was not usable because TLS verification reported a hostname mismatch; verification was not disabled. No geometry, schema, CRS or stable native parcel ID was retrieved.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [-17.0691708465801, 15.7237660210887] was preserved; no exact-point hit/miss inference was made.
No Ondjiva city boundary or complete city coverage was established for an open geometry service.
No parcel geometry, stable native parcel identity, source schema or CRS was retrieved or retained.
IGCA national authority prose and national property-registration workflows are not treated as proof of an Ondjiva-local registry adapter.
An authentication wall, TLS failure or unavailable map route is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account or personal fields were requested or retained.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only, if independently confirmed
source layer and public service metadata
excludedFields: tax/account/registration details beyond a safe native parcel ID
nativeIdentityPolicy: No native parcel identity was observed; no synthetic identity was created. A future retained sample must use exactly one stable native identity in GeoJSON properties and document its source field here.
serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review still required
uncertainty: The national cadastral custodian and property-registration services are evidenced, but Ondjiva-local registry status, public anonymous geometry access, city scope, schema, CRS and stable native parcel IDs remain unknown.
